meetings.title: Ridgeline Software <> Acme — Discovery
meetings.transcript_text: Dana Ruiz: Set the scene for me, what is going on internally that made this a priority now? Lena Fischer: We merged with a smaller company in April and we are now running two CRMs side by side. Nobody trusts either number. Dana Ruiz: What does that cost you? Lena Fischer: Our board deck took eleven days to build last quarter and two of the numbers were wrong when we presented them. Dana Ruiz: Who else needs to be involved in a decision like this? Lena Fischer: Our CFO, Anton Weiss, has to sign anything that touches the finance systems, and he is skeptical of anything that adds a tool. Lena Fischer: There is also Priya on my team who would run the migration day to day, she is called Priya Nandi. Dana Ruiz: What does the process look like from here? Lena Fischer: We do a written evaluation against three vendors, then a reference call, then Anton signs. No pilots, we do not have the time. Dana Ruiz: And the timing? Lena Fischer: We need this live before our fiscal year starts in February, so a decision by the middle of October. Dana Ruiz: Anyone else in the mix? Lena Fischer: We are talking to Beacon as well, they came recommended by our board. Dana Ruiz: What is the right next step? Lena Fischer: Send me the written evaluation template and I will fill it in with Priya by the twentieth of August.

transcript.speaker: Omar Haddad
transcript.text: Just so you know, the clinical team and the commercial team are both talking to you and we have not compared notes.

transcript.speaker: Omar Haddad
transcript.text: What I need is one place where a rep can see the account without opening four tabs.

transcript.speaker: Omar Haddad
transcript.text: Budget is set at the group level and I do not control it, that sits with our COO.
